tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.matchup: Golden State Warriors @ Los Angeles Lakers
games.take: The nightcap on ESPN is the week's most-bet game, and the market has already spoken once: Lakers opened -7.5 and got bet down to -6.5 with 77% of tickets on Golden State. That's public steam, not sharp — and our number still prices LA nearly 7 in 10. Curry is playing through the ankle, but the Warriors are down Porziņģis, Butler, and Moody, while Luka opens his ninth season at home in the first Lakers opener of the post-LeBron era. No true edge at -6.5 against our fair line, but if you're picking a side, the value sits with the home favorite, not the steamed dog.
games.title: Lakers vs Warriors

games.take: Giannis makes his Heat debut at the Kaseya Center on ESPN, with LaMelo Ball debuting for Minnesota on the other side — two franchise-altering introductions in one game. Our fair line calls it essentially a coin flip (52.7/47.3), so there is no true edge at -1.5; this is a story game, not a numbers game. The lean goes to Miami at home with Bam expected back and the debut energy in the building, but bet it like the toss-up our number says it is.
games.title: Heat vs Timberwolves

games.market: New Mexico State -2.5, O/U 45 (total steamed down from 46.5; spread ticked from -2.5 to -3 at some shops)
games.matchup: New Mexico State Aggies @ Sam Houston Bearkats
games.our_fair: New Mexico State 55.1% / Sam Houston 44.9% (devigged Pinnacle)
games.take: The only football on the board tonight, and the market is telling a sharp story: the total fell two points despite tracked money landing on the Over, and the spread ticked toward NMSU despite tracked money on Sam Houston — textbook reverse line movement pointing at the Aggies and the Under. NMSU's Adam Damante is confirmed starting at QB, and the Aggies' run game (James Jones) lines up against a Sam Houston defense allowing 200+ rushing yards a game. Weather is a non-factor: clear, 69°F, no alerts in Walker County. No true edge at the number, but the lean follows the sharp money: NMSU -2.5.
games.title: New Mexico State @ Sam Houston
games.venue: Elliott T. Bowers Stadium, Huntsville, TX

games.take: Tyrese Haliburton plays his first regular-season game in 472 days after the Achilles tear, with Ivica Zubac debuting at center for Indiana. Our fair line prices the Pacers 6 in 10 on the road — the strongest road number on the board outside the big favorites. New Orleans has Jamahl Mosley coaching his first game and a talented but unproven mix around Zion. Nothing cleared our 0.75% edge bar at US books, so this stays a lean, not a play: Pacers -3.5, with the fair line doing the talking.
games.title: Pacers @ Pelicans

games.take: Damian Lillard plays his first regular-season game in a year and a half, back in Portland alongside Ja Morant and Jrue Holiday in a 10-deep rotation. Our fair line has the Blazers at 57.1% — a real home edge that the -2.5 only partly reflects. Phoenix is sorting out its center rotation with Mark Williams out after shoulder surgery. No verified edge at a US book, so it's a lean: Trail Blazers -2.5, because the fair number says the home court is worth more than the market is charging.
games.title: Suns @ Trail Blazers

games.take: Kevin Durant opens his 20th season 1,047 points behind Kobe for fourth on the all-time list, and our fair line gives Houston nearly 8 in 10 at home — the second-heaviest favorite on the slate. Dallas counters with year-two Cooper Flagg and a first-time NBA head coach in Dusty May, plus a thin frontcourt with Santi Aldama doubtful. Nine is a big number and there's no verified edge in it, but the lean is straightforward: the fair line says the gap between these teams is real, so Rockets -9.
games.title: Mavericks @ Rockets

games.take: Kawhi Leonard plays his first regular-season game for Toronto since the 2019 title run, and our fair line makes the Raptors the heaviest favorite on the board at 80.8%. The market has already moved this from -8.5 to -9.5, and the matchup backs it: Toronto swept all three meetings last season by 30, 9, and 16, while Chicago is without Nic Claxton for ~2 weeks. Double-digit spreads are never comfortable, but the lean is Raptors -9.5 — the fair line and the head-to-head history agree.
games.title: Bulls @ Raptors
